name: Rainbow Network BD
notes:
Rainbow Network is a licensed Upazila/Thana-level Internet Service Provider (ISP) in Bangladesh, approved by the Bangladesh Telecommunications Regulatory Commission (BTRC).Since its inception in 2016, the company has been delivering reliable and uninterrupted internet services to end users across Dupchanchia Upazila of Bogura District.
With a strong network infrastructure and customer-focused services, Rainbow Network is recognized as one of the most trusted and high-quality ISPs in the Dupchanchia region.
